name: Audit Sample Selection / Reservoir Sampling (Algorithm R, Seeded) Agent
description: Audit Sample Selection / Reservoir Sampling (Algorithm R, Seeded) Agent — a governed Pause fabric agent (agentforce, A2A). Governance tier: payer-operations. Enforces 4 Pause Agent Fabric policies. Prototype agent card — synthetic data, no real PHI.

skills.name: Given a stream of record ids, a target sample size k, and...
skills.description: Given a stream of record ids, a target sample size k, and a seed, draws a statistically-defensible k-record sample in a single pass (uniform k/n inclusion probability), reporting the selected ids, the population size, the inclusion probability, and the seed (disposition sampled / full-population). A deterministic payer-operations compliance-sampling agent; it COMPLEMENTS the Fraud-Waste-Abuse and Duplicate-Claim Screen agents — they flag records, this selects a defensible sample of records to audit

skills.name: The draw is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the reques...
skills.description: The draw is DETERMINISTIC — a pure function of the request's own ids + k + seed via a seeded PRNG (time is data: the ids are plain data, no real clock, no OS randomness; not a Bloom filter, a knapsack, an EDF schedule, a percentile/rank, a token bucket, or a keyed set-difference but RESERVOIR SAMPLING — single-pass uniform selection with Vitter's Algorithm R); the same request always yields the same sample

skills.name: The sample must be sourced + self-consistent — a real sub...
skills.description: The sample must be sourced + self-consistent — a real subset of the submitted stream (no fabricated id, no over-count duplicate), size min(k, n), honest population size and inclusion probability; a fabricated id, a duplicate pick, or a mis-sized sample is blocked at the Agent Fabric governance boundary (policy.auditsample.sample-sourced, the sourced + self-consistency gate); and the selection must be reproducible — re-running the seeded Algorithm R must reproduce the exact sample; a cherry-picked or otherwise unreproducible draw is blocked (policy.auditsample.selection-reproducible, the load-bearing correctness gate). Mirrors the Duplicate-Claim Screen Agent's filter-sourced + membership-exact posture

skills.name: The agent SELECTS and RECOMMENDS — it NEVER opens, adjudi...
skills.description: The agent SELECTS and RECOMMENDS — it NEVER opens, adjudicates, flags, or acts on a sampled record (each is an audit action that must be authorized) on its own; a sample that auto-audits or is not review-gated is blocked (policy.auditsample.no-autonomous-audit), and every sample is confirmed by a compliance auditor who runs the audit. Mirrors the Duplicate-Claim Screen Agent's no-autonomous-reject and the Contact Rate Limit Agent's no-autonomous-send posture

skills.name: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic ids — clearly labeled...
skills.description: Runs against ILLUSTRATIVE synthetic ids — clearly labeled; NOT a certified statistical-sampling / audit system (real audit sampling weighs stratification, RAT-STATS / OIG methodology, confidence intervals, and dollar-unit / probability-proportional-to-size designs — not a bare uniform reservoir over illustrative ids). PHI-adjacent — record ids, so a sample is on the HIPAA audit path
